excerpts: Over the previous three seasons with the Lions, linebacker [Alex Anzalone](https://www.nfl.com/players/alex-anzalone/) watched [Jahmyr Gibbs](https://www.nfl.com/players/jahmyr-gibbs/) twist defenses into a pretzel. After signing in Tampa Bay this offseason, Anzalone now has to try to stop the dynamic running back when Detroit hosts the Buccaneers [in Week 11](https://www.nfl.com/games/buccaneers-at-lions-2026-reg-11?tab=overview) .

Gibbs is coming off a dominant performance, generating 252 scrimmage yards and two touchdowns in the Lions' [Week 10 win](https://www.nfl.com/games/patriots-at-lions-2026-reg-10?tab=recap) over the New England Patriots. He became just the second player to have four games with at least 200 scrimmage yards and two touchdowns before age 25, joining LaDainian Tomlinson, who had five such games from 2002 to 2003.

Gibbs leads the NFL with 1,000 rushing yards and 11 rushing TDs.
